sections.Trappings: Robes, Ball and Chain, 3 doses of Mad Cap Mushrooms

notes: Ball and Chain is on p. 143, Melee (Goblin Loonie), Long, SB+6, Impact, Wrap, Pummel, Damaging. Review against existing Ball and Chain options and source priority.
